mira: quick heads-up — taking preflight SLO snapshot for EU window tomorrow 06:00 UTC. who to include?
dan: p95 per-route, p99 embed, 5xx rate, kv-cache miss%, error-budget burn, model fallback counts.
syl: add kernel-fallback counter and gpu queue depth. we had a kernel fallback cluster last night.
sre-bot: alert-sim: embed-route p95 +30% vs baseline (110ms -> 143ms) in last 40m. sample trace id trace-cc9.
mira: was there a staging roll?
dan: quantize-v2.1.4-rc3 -> staging at ~03:00 UTC. no prod push.
syl: pulling trace: found kernel fallback spikes on gpu-node-15 and elevated KV latency; few 502 tails.
mira: recommendation: hold the EU traffic shift and pin eu-embed to v2.1.4-rc2 for the change window. run kernel regressions on rc3 overnight.
dan: agree. add release note line and changelog mention: "EU deploy held: eu-embed pinned to v2.1.4-rc2 pending runtime kernel regression on rc3 (RED-4219)."
deploy-bot: pin action recorded by @mira -> route=eu-embed, version=v2.1.4-rc2, reason="staging p95 rise with rc3 kernel fallbacks". ticket RED-4219.
sre-bot: smoke on pinned version (2k samples): p95=114ms, 5xx=0.06%, kv-miss=2.0% -> smoke OK.
dan: plan: 1) update release notes + changelog, 2) run kernel regression matrix overnight on rc3, 3) re-eval at 04:30 UTC, final go/no-go at 05:00 UTC.
mira: ramp plan if green: 10% -> 30% -> 60%, abort if p95 > 1.25x baseline or 5xx > 0.5% or kernel-fallback-rate > 2x baseline.
sre-bot: saved ramp_policy on RED-4219. tagging oncall @dan @syl please ack hold and keep watch overnight. i'll post final snapshot at 04:30 UTC.
dan: ack.
syl: ack. :thumbsup:
mira: i'll merge release notes with hold note and include unpin command: `deploy-bot pin remove --route eu-embed --version v2.1.4-rc2`. will update after regression results.
(END)
